faq.spamAnswer: No. Every email is sent directly from your own email account via SMTP — not from a shared bulk-sending server. Your customer sees your name, your email address, and a message written in your voice. It lands in the inbox like a personal note, not a marketing blast.
faq.providersAnswer: Any provider that supports SMTP works: Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, Apple iCloud Mail, cPanel/Zoho business email, and virtually any hosting provider's mail server. If you can set up an email app on your phone, you can connect it to ReviewLink.
faq.freeAnswer: Yes — free with no artificial sending limits. You connect your own email account, so the only limit is your email provider's daily sending cap (Gmail allows ~500/day, most others are similar). There are no hidden fees and no credit card required to get started.
faq.importQuestion: Can I import my customer list?
faq.importAnswer: Yes. You can upload a CSV file with your customers' names and email addresses, or sync directly from WooCommerce if you run an online store. Once imported, you can bulk-select contacts and send personalised review requests in a single click.
faq.a1: No. Every email is sent directly from your own email account via SMTP — not from a shared bulk-sending server. Your customer sees your name, your email address, and a message written in your voice.
faq.a2: Any provider that supports SMTP works: Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, Apple iCloud Mail, cPanel/Zoho business email, and virtually any hosting provider's mail server.
faq.a3: Yes — free with no artificial sending limits. You connect your own email account, so the only limit is your email provider's daily sending cap.

smtp.title: Correo electrónico Conectarion (SMTP)
smtp.description: Conectar your own email account to send review requests. We encrypt your password and never share it.
smtp.gmailGuideStep2: Turn on 2-Step Verification if not already on
smtp.gmailGuideStep3: Go to myaccount.google.com/apppasswords → name it ReviewLink → click Create
smtp.gmailGuideStep4: Copy the 16-character code and paste it here — remove all spaces
smtp.gmailGuideTip: Tip: use a dedicated reviews@gmail.com account to keep your main inbox separate.
smtp.googleWorkspaceGuideStep1: Ask your Workspace admin to enable 2-Step Verification in admin.google.com
smtp.googleWorkspaceGuideStep2: Sign in to myaccount.google.com with your work account → Security
smtp.googleWorkspaceGuideStep3: Go to myaccount.google.com/apppasswords → name it ReviewLink → click Create
smtp.googleWorkspaceGuideStep4: Copy the 16-character code and paste it here — remove all spaces
smtp.outlookGuideStep3: Under App passwords, click Create a new app password
smtp.outlookGuideStep4: Copy and paste the generated password here
smtp.outlookGuideTip: Microsoft 365 (work accounts): contact your IT admin to allow SMTP AUTH for your mailbox.
smtp.yahooGuideStep3: Select Other app, name it ReviewLink
smtp.yahooGuideStep4: Copy and paste the password here
smtp.zohoGuideStep3: Click your email address → scroll to SMTP
smtp.zohoGuideStep4: Toggle Allow SMTP Access to ON, then use your regular Zoho password here
smtp.zohoGuideTip: No app password needed — just enable SMTP and use your normal Zoho login password.
smtp.aolGuideStep3: Select Other app, name it ReviewLink
smtp.aolGuideStep4: Copy and paste the password here — do not use your regular AOL password
smtp.aolGuideTip: AOL requires 2-step verification to be enabled before generating app passwords.
smtp.protonMailGuideStep1: Download and install Proton Mail Bridge from proton.me/mail/bridge
smtp.protonMailGuideStep2: Sign in to Bridge with your Proton account
smtp.protonMailGuideStep3: In Bridge, click your account → copy the SMTP password shown
smtp.protonMailGuideStep4: Paste that SMTP password here — not your regular Proton login password
smtp.protonMailTip: ProtonMail Bridge must be running on your computer for SMTP to work. Use port 1025 (localhost) or 587 via Bridge.
smtp.fastmailGuideStep1: Go to app.fastmail.com → Configuración → Privacy & Security
smtp.fastmailGuideStep2: Click App passwords → New app password
smtp.fastmailGuideStep3: Name it ReviewLink, select SMTP, then click Generate password
smtp.fastmailGuideStep4: Copy and paste the generated password here
smtp.iCloudGuideTitle: Apple iCloud Mail App Contraseña — 4 steps
smtp.iCloudGuideStep1: Go to appleid.apple.com and sign in
smtp.iCloudGuideStep2: Under Sign-In and Security, click App-Specific Contraseñas
smtp.iCloudGuideStep3: Click Generate an app-specific password..., name it ReviewLink, click Create
smtp.iCloudGuideStep4: Copy the xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx password and paste it here
smtp.iCloudTip: Two-factor authentication must be enabled for your Apple ID.
